summary_markdown: The discussion focused on the necessity of using explicit AWS access keys and secret keys versus utilizing IAM roles for accessing resources. It was noted that while using a role might be cleaner, since various credentials (database logins, tokens for Facebook/Google) are already stored in configuration files, removing the keys is not considered critical. A suggestion was made to retrieve parameters and credentials from the AWS console instead of hardcoding them.
decisions: No immediate decision on credential management method.
action_items: Investigate retrieving all necessary parameters and credentials directly from the AWS console/Parameters store.
